notes.title: Clarification on Our Game's Free Promotion & Refutation of Conspiracy Theories
notes.content: [p]Recently, we have been in continuous communication with Steam Support regarding the [b]duration of our game's free promotion[/b]. The support team has also walked us through the potential drawbacks, advantages, and disadvantages of the free offering. Additionally, they assisted us in enabling the free access permission this past Monday morning; however, this free version remains [b]hidden[/b]—as we still need to confirm the official launch time, it is currently not visible on the store page.[/p][p]Below is the launch timeline for this version, along with its "hidden" status:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/54ebf6c4e1259722befa0076c56cca26344480b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This is the current status in our backend: You can see that the free package is marked as "hidden" and not yet available to the public.[/p][p][/p][p]It seems even the Steam team was unaware that, with the hidden free version active and the paid version not yet fully removed, users could still claim the free version directly via their [b]Steam Wishlist[/b]. I only discovered this issue today myself. Immediately after learning about it, I sent a follow-up email to Steam Support to inform them of this situation and requested that they process [b]refunds for players who purchased the game recently[/b] (after the unintended free access became available).[/p][p]To clarify: The original purpose of our free promotion is to ensure that [b]players who have already purchased the game can continue to access the game’s ongoing updates[/b]. There are no hidden agendas or "conspiracy" behind this decision. We simply hope new players can enjoy the game, and existing players can benefit from sustained support.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your help in dispelling any conspiracy theories surrounding this matter—there is no truth to unfounded speculations. Thank you for your understanding![/p]

notes.title: 《The Leviathan's fantasy》2.5.1
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,​[/p][p]Previously, we offered free Key applications to replace game versions for existing players. However, as of this month, the number of supplementary Keys distributed has exceeded 30% of the total sales volume prior to this initiative—and we still receive numerous feedbacks from players stating they haven’t received their Keys, along with complaints about slow email response times.​[/p][p](We have found that some players have sold the obtained Keys on certain third-party platforms. Currently, we lack an effective method to verify the authenticity of each order and whether the same screenshot is used to claim Keys repeatedly.)​[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, we have decided to make [i]The Leviathan's fantasy[/i] available for free redemption over the next 2 months. All players can obtain the game for free during this period. Meanwhile, we will compensate players who previously purchased the game with the latest paid DLC. After this period, the game will revert to its original price of 78 RMB.​[/p][p]Since [i]Fantasy City[/i] has been launched on many free game platforms overseas, the project team's financial pressure has been slightly relieved. As a result, we will continue to maintain updates and iterations for this standalone game, ensuring its content is continuously improved and expanded. Please rest assured to enjoy the game.​[/p][p]Below are the update contents for this version, which will be completed by September 5th:​[/p][p][/p][p]1.Model and Workshop Migration​[/p][p]We have split all character models from [i]Fantasy City[/i] and added them to the Steam Workshop. Ranging from facial features and body shapes to hairstyles and accessories, you can create any character you desire in the Workshop. This upd[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/48b1f6104820496ed9d32ef83b4d275d15f01fe3.png"][/img]ate has also significantly improved the quality of character modeling.​[/p][p][/p][p]2.Added a large number of new adventurers, who will arrive via airships from Europe and Asia.​[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/33eaee5902b5f6e8002d3cbb84bb1f46282d45ad.png"][/img][/p][p]3.Added brand-new buildings to the Auction House: Christmas Tree, Fountain Square, Children's Playground, Citizen Square, and Baby Dragon Lair.​[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/4c03625014d53cdb452d9c7c31b969987633eae7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content in the [i]Fantasy City[/i] DLC (Same Name)​[/b][/p][p]This DLC will be launched after passing Steam's review.​[/p][list][*][p]New Floating Island: Sky City​[/p][/*][/list][p]Added brand-new quests, NPCs, and a wealth of rewards, as well as the summoning scroll for the new BOSS, Sword God.​[/p][list][*][p]New BOSS: Sword God​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Mount: Spinal Armored Dragon​[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, a large number of brand-new buildings have been added to the Auction House and stage quests, including Ferris Wheel, Carousel, Roller Coaster, and Circus Tent.​[/p][p]Four new heroes from Sky City have also been added, all possessing the brand-new Purple Bloodline.[/p]

notes.title: Ver2.4.7
notes.content:
The new DCL "Ancient Gods and Titans" is now available. We have chosen to offer it for free for a certain period until we ensure that everyone can obtain it.

This DLC includes a new colossal divine beast: the Titan, as well as new heroes: Sun Wukong (in the Great Sage form) and Yang Jian (in the Celestial God form).
At the same time, their exclusive divine weapons, the Ruyi Jingu Bang (Golden Cudgel) and the Sanjian Liangren Dao (Three-Pointed Two-Edged Halberd), have been released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/de9bcecfad1c045d4977eaf1492989bcf8b12158.png[/img]


We will also provide an update on the development of the derivative version. We hope that everyone can be patient. We guarantee that you will be among the first to experience this game.
This version initially started as a simplified version of Gensokyo. However, during the development process, new ideas and content were continuously added, resulting in an extended development cycle. Many of the previous game settings were overturned, and simpler approaches were adopted to handle them instead.

Change in Operation Method
The operation method has been changed to placing buildings and constructing roads according to grids. We have reset almost all the buildings (only keeping some decorative items) to ensure a unified architectural style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/a822fb2ac810dfd192609176fbe59c794eeede09.png[/img]
Strong Bond between Adventurers and Buildings
Adventurers can, in addition to going on adventures, serve as store managers in some shops to increase the store's revenue or assist in the production of supplies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/f980deef4a7eec521b2c85d7a6efc0852313e5cf.png[/img]
Optimization of Adventurer Models
We have unified the rendering and style of adventurers and remade the effects of all bloodlines to ensure that when adventurers merge bloodlines, they don't look too strange.

War Pets
We have introduced a new concept. You can domesticate pets in the city. These pets include elephants, dragons, wolves, etc. You need to build homes for the pets. These pets can be summoned to assist in battles in dungeons and some special scenarios, and they will also interact with tourists in the city, increasing their consumption.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/28f9cd6195d410fca0d4062f8ab1e688615feb39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/2f91be73f9010c18dcaa80bf58489cd910b30dbe.png[/img]
Optimization of Dungeon Battle Performance
In the dungeon, up to 8 adventurers will be allowed to fight simultaneously, and some of the war pets from the city will also be allowed to be brought in. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/cc7e209f5d9465a1c227eaad05e1860368b395ee.png[/img]

notes.title: Ver2.4.6
notes.content:
1.Added a new DLC, "Million Dragons".
This DLC includes divine dragons of five mount qualities. Divine dragons possess the most powerful attributes. After breeding, there is a probability of obtaining attributes that exceed those of mutated mounts by 20%.
Added the artifact - Divine Dragon Sword and its corresponding recipe.
When using this weapon, there is a probability of summoning a divine dragon to assist in the attack. It is the only weapon with a special attack skill.
Added two divine dragon bloodlines. These bloodlines have special effects, and when attacking, a dragon soul will possess the character, and this effect can stack multiple times.

2.Optimized the models, textures, and icons of divine dragons.
Re - opened the Creative Workshop and fixed the problem that self - created characters could not be seen.

3.Fixed the problem that some achievements could not be activated correctly. (If there are still 
achievements that cannot be activated correctly in the future, please feedback to us.)

4.Fixed the problem of abnormal movement of horse mounts.


If you have purchased the game before, you can send the purchase voucher to the email xingyiwangluo2025@163.com to receive the activation code of this DLC for free.

notes.title: Ver2.4.5（Beta）
notes.content:
The new version has been updated to Beta. If there are no bugs for two consecutive days, it will be moved to the official version. This will be the process from now on. Those who don't mind can switch to the Beta version to experience the updated content in advance.


We've added a plugin management feature, which can be found at the bottom - right corner of the game's main menu interface. Currently, it only supports these functions. If you have new requirements, please leave a message in the discussion area, and we'll consider adding them accordingly.
(To avoid significantly affecting your gaming experience, some overly exaggerated modifications will not be available. The currently available content can mostly greatly shorten the time it takes to gather resources and help you quickly get through the early stages of the game.)


1.Fixed an issue where there was a chance that the mouse couldn't be moved when both the left and right mouse buttons were clicked on the technology icon simultaneously.
2.Fixed a problem where saving was not possible when there were too many save files.
3.Fixed a crash that occurred under specific circumstances.
4.Readded the achievement feature.
5.The Creative Workshop will be reopened in the next update.
6.Retranslated the untranslated parts in the English version.

A level - 0 new account maliciously slandered and spread rumors in the store review section, such as claiming that the Gensokyo project is a skin - swapping mass - produced game and that we're about to abandon it. As a result, many casual players believed these rumors. If you come across any rumors about the Gensokyo project being a skin - swapping game or us planning to abandon it, we hope you can help clarify the truth and leave a refuting comment in the store review section. This is of great importance to us. Thank you.

Finally, we will release the first DLC before next Friday and reopen the Creative Workshop.

notes.title: Ver2.4.3
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where releasing certain skills could cause the game to crash.
2.Fixed the display bug caused by a large number of engine upgrades.
3.Added new bloodlines: Dragonborn, Jungle Great Bear, Children of Chaos, as well as Dragon Clan, Bear Spirit, Chaos Offspring, etc.
4.ignificantly increased the rewards of world bosses.
5.Added a large number of new bloodline materials in various locations throughout the game.

We have received numerous suggestions from veteran players. In the next version, we will build in a game modifier to make the gameplay smoother. (New players should use it with caution as it may affect the gaming experience to some extent.)

At the same time, the new DLC "Giant Mythical Beasts: Frost Giants" and new elven legendary heroes are under optimization and will be released in the upcoming versions.

notes.title: 关于游戏重新上架公告
notes.content:
For certain reasons, we have relisted this game to ensure its future updates and maintenance. "My Gensokyo" will continue to fix bugs and will be sold at a price lower than 10% off within the next month. Meanwhile, at least two free DLCs will be updated to express our gratitude for everyone's support.
To thank you all for your waiting and support, we will directly update our new game, a derivative game of Gensokyo - "The leviathan's fantasy", in this game store later. This new game will be updated in the form of the Beta version of "Celestial City Fantasy". Players who purchase this version can play this new game for free as soon as it's available.
This is a game optimized based on various aspects of Gensokyo. We have removed many complicated gameplay elements, reduced a large number of redundant operations and optimized most of the systems, such as the technology system, reincarnation system, and mission release system.
The technology tree has been redesigned and distributed among most of the buildings. Each building has its own technology tree. Technology points can be accumulated by receiving consumers or through production in buildings to unlock different skins and forms.
Optimization of the floating island gameplay: The floating island has added an area design and an operation interface. On the interface, adventurers can be directly assigned to certain areas to fight monsters and level up.
The graphics have been completely reset. Except for some heroes with nice models and the airship models that have been retained, all buildings, plants and floating islands have been completely redone, including those buildings that were previously criticized a lot for their different styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/4598b4c8fb6f51e6879ae5c18bf0c34d6f0bacb8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/35a952a456e6116fef080a4be675013b2baf579f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329383/fb1839b19769418ac48a95bdc6797af9ea96bfb4.png[/img]

I won't list them one by one for the time being. This derivative game is expected to have a development cycle of three more months. I hope everyone can wait patiently and don't be easily influenced by others. Actually, indie games don't make much money. We have been updating "The leviathan's fantasy" for two years, ensuring hundreds of hours of gameplay. As a single-player paid game, it should be considered qualified. I believe the veteran players from the very beginning can see the progress of the game (at least when it comes to bugs, everyone should have a deep understanding). Because there are few similar games with this kind of gameplay. Most of them are just small games that don't go very deep. We are willing to take risks and accumulate technology. So in the end, our whole team has suffered serious losses on the whole. For a formal game that has been on sale for two years and has been continuously updated hundreds of times, there should be no reason to suspect that we will abandon it.
